segments.sn22.45:1.5: yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn22.45:1.6: Evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi.
segments.sn22.45:1.7: Vedanā aniccā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ.
segments.sn22.45:1.13: yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn22.45:1.14: Evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi.
segments.sn22.45:1.15: Rūpadhātuyā ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cittaṃ virattaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti anupādāya āsavehi, vedanādhātuyā … pe … saññādhātuyā … saṅkhāradhātuyā … viññāṇadhātuyā ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cittaṃ virattaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti anupādāya āsavehi.
segments.sn22.45:1.19: Vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. Ṭhitattā santusitaṃ [santussitaṃ (ka. sī. pī. ka.)]. Santusitattā na paritassati. Aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
segments.sn22.45:1.20: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: Tatiye sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbanti saha vipassanāya maggapaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Anupādāya āsavehīti anuppādanirodhena niruddhehi āsavehi agahetvā iti vimuccati.
Aggahetvāti evaṃ nirujjhamānehi āsavehi “ahaṃ mamā”ti kañci dhammaṃ anādiyitvā.
“Cittaṃ virattaṃ, vimuttaṃ hotī”ti vuttattā phalaṃ gayhati,“khīṇā jātī”tiādinā paccavekkhaṇāti āha “saha phalena paccavekkhaṇadassanatthan”ti.
